title: Unlikely Heroes
intro: [excited] Tonight's heroes are the little guys! Ants, robots, rats, mice and bad guys who want to be good. [laughs] If you've ever been picked last for kickball, this board is for you.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A tiny glowing hero cape lying across a giant boulder on a mountaintop at sunrise, a small trail of footprints leading up to it, dramatic clouds parting.

categories.title: Bug Heroics
categories.intro: Our film category is A Bug's Life! One clumsy inventor ant versus a gang of greedy grasshoppers.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An anthill colony on a tiny island under a giant dandelion, seed-pod harvest piles, a dry riverbed, leaves the size of sails, golden late-summer light.

clues.clue: Flik, the clumsy inventor hero of A Bug's Life, is this kind of insect.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an ant! [chuckles] He's tiny, he's clumsy, and he invented a harvester that wrecks the food offering. Hero material.

clues.clue: This bossy leader of the grasshopper gang demands food from the ants every summer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hopper! [whispers] He's one of Pixar's scariest villains, because he knows the ants outnumber him 100 to 1.

clues.clue: The ants' young royal, who becomes queen by the end of the film, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Princess Atta! Her little sister Dot is the one who believes in Flik from the start. [chuckles] Little sisters always know.

clues.clue: To scare off the grasshoppers, Flik and the circus bugs build a fake one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a bird! Grasshoppers are terrified of birds. [laughs] Until it catches fire. Oops.

clues.clue: Flik's warrior squad is actually a group of out-of-work circus performers from the circus run by this flea.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is P.T. Flea! A pun on P.T. Barnum. He fires his whole troupe, and they turn into heroes. [chuckles] Talk about a career change.

categories.title: Underdog Days
categories.intro: Next, Underdog Days! These characters were doubted, laughed at or picked last, and they saved the day anyway.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A tiny glowing medal on a ribbon resting on a dusty wooden step, a beam of sunlight streaming down on it from a high window.

clues.clue: This nine-foot arcade bad guy with giant fists goes game-jumping to prove he can be a good guy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Wreck-It Ralph! [chuckles] I'm bad, and that's good. I will never be good, and that's not bad.

clues.clue: This little bird in a 2005 Disney film says the sky is falling. Nobody believes him, but he's sort of right.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chicken Little! It was an alien spaceship. [laughs] So, technically, the sky was falling. Vindicated.

clues.clue: In Zootopia, she becomes the city's first bunny police officer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Judy Hopps! Everyone told her bunnies can't be cops. [excited] Then she cracked the biggest case in Zootopia!

clues.clue: In The Great Mouse Detective, this Baker Street mouse is the hero who matches wits with Ratigan.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Basil of Baker Street! He lives under Sherlock Holmes. [chuckles] Literally, in the basement.

clues.clue: In The Black Cauldron, the hero is a young assistant to a pig keeper named this.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Taran! An assistant pig-keeper who saves the world. [laughs] Talk about a resume booster.

categories.title: Zoom to the Rescue
categories.intro: It's a zoom category! We're starting super close. Each image is an object tied to an unlikely hero. Name the hero as fast as you can.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A giant magnifying glass held over a tiny backpack of heroic gear: a feather, a small boot, a leather journal and a chef hat, on a sunlit wooden desk.

clues.clue: Name the unlikely hero linked to this object.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is WALL-E! A trash-compacting robot keeps a tiny plant in an old boot, and saves all of humanity. [sighs] Plants are hard to keep alive.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A small green seedling with two leaves planted in a dirty old work boot, sitting on a rusty metal shelf beside stacked cubes of compacted trash, a hazy orange sky outside.

clues.clue: Name the unlikely hero linked to this object.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dumbo! The crows gave him a magic feather, but it turns out the magic was in his ears all along. [chuckles] What a twist.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A single glossy black crow feather drifting through the air above a red-and-white striped circus tent, a tiny round peanut on the ground.

clues.clue: Name the unlikely hero linked to this object.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Remy! A rat who can cook. [laughs] Health inspectors everywhere hate this movie.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A tiny white chef's toque the size of a thimble on a gleaming steel kitchen counter, a sprig of thyme and a tiny wooden spoon beside a huge copper pot.

clues.clue: Name the unlikely hero linked to this object.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bolt! A TV-star dog who thinks he has superpowers learns he's an ordinary pup who's a hero anyway. [chuckles] Just a really good boy.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A white dog collar with a painted black lightning bolt lying on a Hollywood soundstage floor beside a squeaky toy carrot, spotlights and camera rigs.

clues.clue: Name the unlikely hero linked to this object.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Milo Thatch! A linguist with a dusty journal leads the way to Atlantis. [laughs] Turns out reading IS a superpower.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An old leather journal open on a desk to a map of a sunken city, a glowing blue crystal pendant on a cord lying across the pages, a pair of round glasses, a submarine visible through a porthole.

categories.title: Heroes in the Making
categories.intro: Parks time! At the parks, YOU get to be the unlikely hero. [laughs] Even if you can barely carry your churro.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A theme park queue line with a space-ranger badge, a tiny train engine on a track and a giant tree trunk carved with animal shapes, sunny afternoon.

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom, guests spin their cars and zap Zurg as space rangers on this Tomorrowland ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin! [laughs] My score proves I am NOT a space ranger.

clues.clue: This little circus engine from Dumbo puffs I think I can up a hill, and gives his name to a Disneyland train ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Casey Jr.! [excited] The Casey Jr. Circus Train has been chugging around Fantasyland since 1955. I think I can, I think I can!

clues.clue: Flik starred in this 3D show inside Animal Kingdom's Tree of Life from 1998 until it closed in 2025.
clues.answer: It's Tough to Be a Bug!
accept: it's tough to be a bug
its tough to be a bug
choices: It's Tough to Be a Bug!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is It's Tough to Be a Bug! [laughs] The stink bug. The seats that poke you. Classic theme park chaos.

clues.clue: In 2025, a new 3D show starring Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde opened in the Tree of Life. It's based on this film.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Zootopia! The show is called Zootopia: Better Zoogether, and it opened in November 2025. Bunny cops, assemble!

clues.clue: Pinocchio's Daring Journey, about a puppet who becomes a real boy, is at Disneyland, Tokyo Disneyland and this third park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disneyland Paris! [chuckles] Magic Kingdom never got one. Pinocchio is a little wooden boy with a very exclusive travel schedule.

categories.title: Mighty Mice
categories.intro: Our fan category! Small but mighty. All these heroes are mice. [chuckles] Squeak your answer in.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A tiny mouse-sized doorway in a baseboard, with a miniature welcome mat, a thimble for a bucket and a matchbox suitcase, in warm lamplight.

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse became a star in this 1928 cartoon, where he whistles at the wheel of a riverboat.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Steamboat Willie! [excited] One of the first cartoons with synchronised sound. The mouse that started it all.

clues.clue: In The Rescuers, Bernard's partner is this elegant Hungarian mouse.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Miss Bianca! [chuckles] Elegant, brave, and great in a crisis. Bernard is the nervous one.

clues.clue: The Rescue Aid Society holds its meetings secretly in the basement of this New York building.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the United Nations! The mice have their own UN, right underneath the human one. [laughs] With better snacks, probably.

clues.clue: In The Great Mouse Detective, Basil's archenemy, who insists he's a big mouse, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Professor Ratigan! Voiced by Vincent Price. [whispers] And whatever you do, don't call him a rat.

clues.clue: In The Rescuers, Bernard and Bianca fly to the swamp on Orville, an albatross. In the sequel, they fly with his brother, named this.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Wilbur! Orville and Wilbur, named for the Wright brothers, the first in flight. [laughs] Airline humour.
